Why choose Kendare

Kendare is a unique platform inspired by the spiritual traditions and cultural wisdom of Sri Lanka, dedicated to offering personalized astrology consultations guided by experienced practitioners. Unlike generic astrology services, we focus on meaningful one-on-one sessions through scheduled video calls, where your birth chart is carefully analyzed and explained in a simple, understandable way. Rooted in genuine care and traditional insight, our approach blends ancient astrological knowledge with a modern consultation experience to bring clarity and direction to your life. To book a session, simply choose your preferred service, and we will connect you with the most suitable astrologer based on your specific concerns.

We encourage you to scroll down and explore more about how Kendare can support your journey, and why many people across Sri Lanka trust us for deeper understanding and life guidance.

An Astrology Research Academy

Kendare is an astrology research academy focused on deep learning, structured training, and meaningful understanding of astrology rather than routine consultations. Our approach is built on careful chart analysis, research-based interpretation, and continuous learning, where every consultation is prepared with depth and responsibility. How we provide Consultancy

At Kendare, we follow a structured Vedic astrology consultation system designed for clarity and accessibility. The process begins with booking your consultation service through our online platform and completing a secure payment.

Once confirmed, you can connect with our astrologers through chat or voice call, allowing you to receive personalized horoscope readings in a comfortable and flexible way. We focus on clear communication so you can easily discuss your concerns and receive meaningful guidance.

All consultations are based on detailed birth chart analysis, where our astrologers carefully study your horoscope to identify the root causes of your challenges. Based on this analysis, we provide practical astrological guidance and suggested remedies aimed at improving your situation and bringing mental clarity.

If you have any further questions after your consultation, we also provide post-consultation support through chat or email to ensure continued guidance when needed.
